name: Mod item knowledge
description: Adds a configurable list of modded items and facts to every NPC prompt, so companions can talk about packs like Create or Farmer's Delight.

facts.label: Items and facts
facts.description: One fact per line. These are quoted to the model as reference data, not as instructions. Leave blank to use the built-in examples.
facts.default:
Create: Andesite Alloy is a common crafting material made from iron and andesite.
Farmer's Delight: cooking pots and cutting boards turn crops into meals such as stew and dumplings.
Supplementaries: faucets can pour liquid from a cauldron, and a rope bale can be climbed.
Waystones: a waystone lets a player teleport between other waystones they have unlocked.
